editorial.headline: Pharmacy Retail That Is Open Nationally—and Not Barred in Bali
editorial.standfirst: A defined pharmacy retail activity spanning medicines, supplements and specified health supplies, open to foreign ownership nationally and not blocked from PMA registration in Bali.
editorial.body:
This activity is the retail sale, through a pharmacy, of pharmaceutical preparations for human use. Its scope is deliberately broad: tablets, capsules, ointments, powders, solutions, parenteral solutions and suspensions all sit within it. It includes preparations associated with skin, eye, dental, ear, respiratory, digestive, hypertension and hormonal conditions, as well as vitamins and health supplements. Specified rubber health necessities are included too, from condoms and breast pumps to blood bags, surgical gloves, family-planning devices and rubber stoppers for pharmaceutical vials. The defining setting is clear: this is pharmacy retail.

The activity is open at every stated business scale: Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar. That breadth matters because the record does not confine pharmacy retail of these products to one size of enterprise. At the same time, the scope remains specific. It is not an undefined claim to health-related retailing; it is framed around human pharmaceutical preparations in their various forms, together with the named health supplies.

For foreign investment, the national position is direct. The activity is marked TERBUKA, with foreign ownership permitted up to 100%. In practical terms, the record presents a fully foreign-open national ceiling for this pharmacy retail activity. There is no lower foreign-ownership cap stated here: a foreign investor may hold up to the full 100% national ceiling.

Bali does not reverse that national position: this activity is not blocked from PMA registration there. The province’s permanent, island-wide moratorium blocks PMA for Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI activities. For this activity at the Besar scale, however, the OSS risk is Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi—medium-high/high risk—so it is not caught by that moratorium. Its Bali status is OK_or_HIGHER_RISK: the record places it outside the provincial block while signalling the higher-risk position associated with the Large scale.
editorial.pullQuote: The national position is fully foreign-open, and Bali does not block PMA registration for this activity.
